summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 1.00. Confirmed account takeover for d.yilmaz@aegean.edu. Evidence chain: (1) phishing email from typosquat domain aegean-edu.co delivered and clicked at 06:12-06:15 on 2026-10-14; (2) MFA fatigue attack from 185.220.101.7 (BulwarkHost Ltd, Amsterdam, NL) — 7 MFA denials then an approval at 06:59, followed by successful mail login from that IP with no known device; (3) immediately after, a mail forwarding rule was created via API to external address d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (07:03), indicating persistence/exfiltration; (4) rapid-fire successful SIS logins from the same Amsterdam IP with no device_id and no MFA (07:34-07:39), showing access to payroll/student systems. The legitimate baseline is IP 193.140.10.44 (Turkcell, Manisa, TR) on device LT-2207. This is not explainable as benign and is more than a weak signal — compromise is confirmed. Immediate containment required: disable account, force password reset, revoke all sessions, remove the forwarding rule, and inspect mail/SIS for data access.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
